opportunities.title: Carry meals from the restaurant pass to table handoff points

opportunities.title: Bring drinks and room-service items to hotel room doors
opportunities.summary: Deliver stocked drawers to a guest’s floor and room-door handoff point. People replenish items and guests retrieve them; lifts and payment systems need integration.
opportunities.setting: Hotel corridors and room-door handoff points

reviewLinks.rationale: The hotel model supports drawer-based room service and configured elevator journeys.
limitations: Confirm exact drawer/cooling configuration and lift interface.
Human replenishment, receipt, cleaning and exceptions remain required.
